requested_operations.label: Read selected account route
requested_operations.effect: The client can read selected account public key and route metadata.

requested_operations.label: Validate signer requests
requested_operations.effect: The client can ask the service to validate signer-request payloads before signer transport.

requested_operations.label: Dispatch signer requests
requested_operations.effect: The client can ask the service to validate, route, dispatch, and verify signer requests through an approved signer route.

requested_operations.label: Verify signer responses
requested_operations.effect: The client can ask the service to verify signer responses before returning them upstream.
